$comment: QA-07 shared contract vectors — single source of truth for the four client packages (acf-cli, mcp-server, autocodeflow-node-sdk, autoflow-sdk). Envelope source: apps/admin-api/src/common/interceptors/response.interceptor.ts. Vectors are append-only (published clients assert on old vectors); changing behavior is a breaking contract change -> bump $schemaVersion and ship all four ends together. See README.md for the full contract description and consumption instructions.

non200SuccessCode.$comment: code mirrors HTTP status; 201 must unwrap exactly like 200

emptyObject.$comment: no data key at all -> not an envelope

arrayBody.$comment: arrays are never envelopes (node-sdk rule; py dict-guard equivalent)

stringCodeEnvelope.$comment: PK-06 unification (2026-09-14, all four ends): the envelope code is always numeric (ResponseInterceptor statusCode ?? 200) — a STRING code is not an envelope. A payload carrying code+message+data with a string code is a business body and must pass through unchanged. Append-only vector pinning the unified 'data key present + numeric code' criterion

statusRange.$comment: anything in success[] must resolve; anything in failure[] must throw/inspect body — no status-specific bypass

errorBody.name: envelope-style single message

raw.message: Invalid or expired execution callback token

errorBody.detail: Invalid or expired execution callback token

errorBody.name: class-validator message array

message: status must be one of the following values

errorBody.detail: executionId must be a UUID; status must be one of the following values

errorBody.name: no detail at all
errorBody.$comment: empty detail -> callers must keep raw status/text, never swallow

knownHeuristicEdge.name: code+message+data on an entity payload (full envelope shape)
knownHeuristicEdge.$comment: documented edge: a payload carrying the FULL envelope shape (code+message+data) is indistinguishable from an envelope and is unwrapped by every end — entities must never carry all three keys. Unified criterion since PK-06 (2026-09-14, all four ends): 'data key present + numeric code' (message no longer tested; string code passes through — see passthrough.stringCodeEnvelope); changing it is a breaking contract change

knownDivergence.name: data+message WITHOUT code
knownDivergence.$comment: 2026-09-14 (PK-06/PK-07 unification, all four ends): cli/mcp tightened to the numeric-code criterion (2026-09-13, WIKI-OPT-4) and node-sdk/py-sdk now match — the envelope test everywhere is 'data key present + code is a number', so this payload (no code key at all) is preserved unchanged by EVERY end. The cli_mcp_unwrapped key above is a historical archive of the pre-2026-09-13 loose heuristic and no longer describes any shipped client. Divergence is closed; see passthrough.stringCodeEnvelope for the pinned string-code vector

channelList.$comment: A4 (DEEP_REVIEW 0ef3bbe): canonical set of notification channel ids. Source of truth in admin-api is the AlertChannel enum (apps/admin-api/src/modules/notification/notification.service.ts); the six channel classes under channels/*.channel.ts each declare their own "name" and admin-web's AlarmConfig carries yet another hand-written option list. Three independent copies drifted: feishu existed in the enum and in NotificationSettingsPage but was MISSING from AlarmConfig's selector (a real defect found while landing this section). This vector pins all copies to one set.
